The '''BL-39 interrogator droid''' was a [[Interrogation droid/Legends|Interrogation droid]] manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]], that was mainly used by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. It was a direct successor of the [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]], which schematics were bought by Aratech after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It could easily be converted into a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical assistant droid]] by making use of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] existing medical knowledge.<ref name="LECG" />

[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] made use of these droids in her role as the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="LECG" />
